From: Lawrence Paulson <lp15@cam.ac.uk>
Subject: [isabelle] New in the Cauchy_Functional_Equation / Regular_Variation / Extreme_Value_Theory

I'm happy to announce a three-session contribution by Michikazu Hirata:

Cauchy's Functional Equation: on functions satisfying h(x+y) = h(x) + h(y)
https://isa-afp.org/entries/Cauchy_Functional_Equation.html

Regular Variation: pm function whose behaviour at infinity is similar to that of a power-law function
https://isa-afp.org/entries/Regular_Variation.html

Extreme Value Theory: EVT is a branch of probability theory and statistics that studies rare events
https://isa-afp.org/entries/Extreme_Value_Theory.html

Larry
